snippet.title: Did a Radio Recording Contain an MSX Game? #RetroComputing
snippet.description:
A faint, sped-up radio recording might hold a computer game. Developer Weber Kai described how he decoded the sound and reported a match with an MSX game. We haven't independently repeated his procedure.

Watch the full film: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0RaC4t7yn5o
